title: Signs and Notices
description: Read the sign or notice and choose the correct meaning.

questions.sign_text: A standard circular prohibition sign on a clean white background with a thick red border and diagonal slash over a modern digital camera with a flash icon, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign mean?
options: Visitors must charge camera batteries before entering the archive room.
Visitors can purchase digital cameras at the memorial museum entrance.
Flash photography is strictly prohibited inside the historical archive.
Taking photos without camera equipment is permitted in the gallery room.
questions.correct_answer: Flash photography is strictly prohibited inside the historical archive.

questions.sign_text: A standard circular prohibition sign on a clean white background with a thick red border and diagonal slash over a person touching an antique historical display pedestal, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign mean?
options: Cleaning historical statues requires wearing protective rubber gloves.
Visitors are encouraged to hold the ancient stone sculptures on display.
Touching the historic artifacts in this exhibition gallery is forbidden.
Standing close to the commemorative exhibition pedestal is not allowed.
questions.correct_answer: Touching the historic artifacts in this exhibition gallery is forbidden.

questions.sign_text: A standard circular mandatory action sign with a deep blue background featuring a crisp white icon of audio guide headphones, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign say?
options: Listening to the biography audio tour via personal headphones is required.
Speaking loudly into audio headsets is strictly forbidden in this section.
Repairing damaged museum headphones can be requested at the service desk.
Visitors should store audio headsets inside the cloakroom before exiting.
questions.correct_answer: Listening to the biography audio tour via personal headphones is required.

questions.sign_text: A standard equilateral triangular warning sign on a clean white background with a bold yellow interior, thick black border, and a black symbol of fragile antique glass showcase display cracking under pressure, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign say?
options: Watch out for high electrical voltage behind the antique museum lighting.
Be aware that the gallery floor has become very slippery after scrubbing.
Caution: the historic glass cabinets are fragile and must not be pushed.
Notice that damaged glassware will be replaced by the restoration team soon.
questions.correct_answer: Caution: the historic glass cabinets are fragile and must not be pushed.

questions.sign_text: A standard equilateral triangular warning sign on a clean white background with a bold yellow interior, thick black border, and a black symbol of a laser beam hazard during film studio production, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign say?
options: Beware: heavy moving cameras might cause loud noise in the production bay.
Notice: overhead stage lighting will be switched off during the rehearsal.
Attention: sound recording microphones are currently active in this studio.
Warning: optical laser equipment is actively operating on the film set.
questions.correct_answer: Warning: optical laser equipment is actively operating on the film set.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins. A sleek brushed metal rectangular plaque displaying bold white and gold text: 'HISTORICAL ARCHIVE: ORAL ACCOUNTS RECORDING IN PROGRESS — SILENCE OBSERVED'. Large high-contrast typography, maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the notice tell us?
options: Oral history recordings have been postponed until the studio opens tomorrow.
Visitors can join the public interview session with veterans this morning.
Sound equipment inside the archive room is currently undergoing repairs now.
People must maintain silence because a wartime interview is being filmed.
questions.correct_answer: People must maintain silence because a wartime interview is being filmed.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins. A realistic yellow textured sticky note with neat handwritten blue ink: 'Hi Leo, I left the biography of the national hero on your desk. Please return it to the library by 4 p.m. today! — Sarah'. High-contrast handwriting, maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the note say?
options: Sarah wants Leo to leave the history book on her study desk after lunch.
Leo should take the borrowed biography back to the library before 4 p.m.
Sarah needs Leo to purchase a new copy of the biography at the bookshop.
Leo has to finish reading the historical biography together with Sarah.
questions.correct_answer: Leo should take the borrowed biography back to the library before 4 p.m.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins. A clean corporate email interface card. Subject: 'Guest Lecture: Military Strategy in World History'. Body: 'Dear students, General Harrison's lecture moves to Hall B at 2 p.m. due to high attendance.' High-contrast typography, maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the email say?
options: General Harrison has cancelled his military history lecture this afternoon.
The historical lecture will take place in a different hall at two o'clock.
The presentation has been extended because many visitors arrived early today.
Students must register online in advance before attending the talk in Hall B.
questions.correct_answer: The historical lecture will take place in a different hall at two o'clock.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins. A stylish vintage bookstore promotional poster: 'HEROES & LEGENDS BOOK FAIR: Buy any two biographies of visionary leaders, receive a documentary DVD for free! Valid this weekend only.' High-contrast typography, maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the notice tell us?
options: Customers get a complimentary documentary DVD when purchasing two biographies.
Visitors receive two free documentary films when buying any history magazine.
All historical books about visionary leaders are discounted by fifty percent.
The book fair offers free biography volumes for anyone visiting this weekend.
questions.correct_answer: Customers get a complimentary documentary DVD when purchasing two biographies.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins. A vibrant cinematic poster for 'INDEPENDENCE FILM FESTIVAL: Screening award-winning resistance war blockbusters from October 10 to 15 at City Cinema. Free admission for students with valid student ID.' High-contrast typography, maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the flyer tell us?
options: Students with valid identification cards can attend the screenings for free.
Moviegoers must purchase tickets online before October 10 to see the films.
The film festival will showcase foreign animated cartoons for secondary kids.
Cinema tickets are fifty percent off for all visitors during the five days.
questions.correct_answer: Students with valid identification cards can attend the screenings for free.
